result.rationale: The new EmbeddableHost model has no uniqueness validation and the migration creates embeddable_hosts without a unique index on host. The admin controller's create action always saves a new EmbeddableHost, so duplicate host rows with different category_id values are possible. record_for_host uses where("lower(host) = ?", host).first without an ORDER BY, so TopicEmbed.import can non-deterministically pick among duplicate rows and assign an unpredictable category_id.
